question: Please identify the top three customers, based on their customer_unique_id, who have the highest number of delivered orders, and provide the average payment value, city, and state for each of these customers.
sql:
-- Final query: top 3 customers by delivered orders with avg payment, city, state
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id
    FROM olist_orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_payments AS (
    SELECT d.order_id, SUM(p.payment_value) as total_payment
    FROM delivered_orders d
    JOIN olist_order_payments p ON d.order_id = p.order_id
    GROUP BY d.order_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        c.customer_city,
        c.customer_state,
        COUNT(d.order_id) as delivered_orders,
        AVG(op.total_payment) as avg_payment_value
    FROM delivered_orders d
    JOIN olist_customers c ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN order_payments op ON d.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_city, c.customer_state
)
SELECT 
    customer_unique_id,
    delivered_orders,
    ROUND(avg_payment_value, 2) as avg_payment_value,
    customer_city,
    customer_state
FROM customer_stats
ORDER BY delivered_orders DESC
LIMIT 3
